programme.title: E7 - Chilema and Her Brother
programme.desc: Chilema is an Elephant with half a trunk; losing the tip to a poacher's snare. It was intended to catch antelope for bushmeat. But the snare's indiscriminate nature means other animals often fall foul of them, with devastating results. Chilema is now having to adapt to life without an elephants most important appendage. She must learn how to eat, drink and also take a mud bath to ensure her survival. With the added challenge of the harsh dry season, Chilema is fighting against the odds to survive.

programme.title: E9
programme.desc: 三位51歲、對人生感到失意的中年大叔——吉井雄太、藤卷肇與菊原紀介，因故鄉傳來「工地挖出人骨」的新聞而重聚。他們原是少年時代的電影研究部夥伴，卻在回憶往昔時，驚覺他們的女顧問老師竟被標註為「行方不明」。這個發現，點燃了他們追查老師神祕失蹤真相的決心，也開啟了一段重新檢視自我與青春的救贖之旅。

programme.desc: 刑警何遠航（潘粵明 飾）與其徒弟冉方旭（王鶴棣 飾）調查一起涉及徐家父女的神秘失蹤案。1997年，二人在元龍里小區電梯口失蹤，冉方旭最初認定案件為惡意逃債，但2006年，徐父的遺體被意外發現，推翻了這一結論。 近十年後，何遠航的女兒、已成為警察的何曉荷（任敏 飾）發現案件與過往線索的關聯。她與父親聯手，欲在小區拆遷前夕最終揭露真相。

programme.title: E1
programme.desc: 講述因童年的坎坷長大後過度沉醉於成功的人生，不停追求自己對名利的慾望，最後被信任的人背叛，試圖擺脫長久以來的慾望及執著的故事。

programme.title: E18
programme.desc: 講述柔道選手出身的女主角溫心（金世正飾），因傷被迫放棄當運動員，轉職網絡漫畫編輯，揭開人生新一頁的同時，亦反映韓國網絡漫畫業界激烈競爭的情况。​

programme.title: E5
programme.desc: 擁有雙重面貌卻守節十五年的蒙面寡婦，在白天是個足不出戶、行為謹慎的女人。到了晚上，她就會翻牆出去，戴著面紗去照顧那些有需要的人。在某天晚上卻遇到了追查年幼時慘死的父親死因的男人。這使她開始對未來有所憧憬。但當他們一起捲入一場意想不到的事件時，生活發生了巨大的變化。

programme.title: E21
programme.desc: 講述了大學畢業三年後，羅豔（李庚希飾）經媽媽介紹進入一家離家不遠的傳統型公司做閒差，別人羨慕她輕鬆悠閒，她卻厭倦了枯燥的生活；出入高檔寫字樓的姜小果（卜冠今飾）實際上每天加班沒有自己的生活；突如其來的家庭經濟危機讓段家寶（董思怡飾）從「富二代」變成了「負二代」；梁爽（關曉彤飾）成了全網頂尖的美妝護膚主播，但她的事業起起伏伏。儘管生活的路總是令人困惑而踟躕，但女孩們從不停止向前的腳步。這是充滿艱難，也充滿光明的25歲。

programme.title: E32
programme.desc: 人生進入瓶頸期的職場精英梁友安和習慣了坐冷板凳的運動員宋三川，因緣際會加入了一個草臺網球俱樂部。他們一個是半路出家的俱樂部經理人，一個是羽毛球轉網球的運動員，兩人和隊友們克服困難共同奮戰，努力打造一個了不起的職業俱樂部。在此過程中，梁友安和宋三川逐漸萌生愛意，也面臨著來自觀念和閱歷的衝突。俱樂部不斷髮展，他們在一次次應對挑戰中超越自我、加強信任，最終收穫職業成長和美好愛情。

programme.title: The Rising Star -Tang Lai Ying
programme.desc: Tang Lai Ying, known as “All-bad-angles pretty girl”, played a club girl-wannabe waitress in the film “Night King” and her comedic performance has won the audience's favor. Despite her cheerful and optimistic personality both on and off screen, she has experienced confusion on her journey to pursue her dreams. Despite of the popularity of her comedic image, she also longs for audiences to see her serious side. In this programme, Lai Ying is going to share her philosophy on happiness, giving everyone a glimpse of her most authentic self.

programme.title: Expect a Miracle
programme.desc: Miss Sung has come to Hong Kong to be a teacher, and hopefully moonlight as a model. On the Internet, she starts to talk with 'Blue Moon', a photographer. While attempting to shoot, the two have an argument, and Sung seems to lose her chance at being a model, until a second consideration by Jet leads to a completed shoot. Love between the two begins to bloom, but Jet's stepsister, who is also one of Miss Sung's students, starts to interfere, and may just ruin everything.

programme.title: 2gether: The Movie
programme.desc: Tine Mr. Chic, a cheeky good-looking university student, finds himself in big trouble after being romantically and aggressively chased by Green, a handsome guy. To push Green away, Tine asks Sarawat, the hottest guy on campus, to pretend to flirt with him. Little does he know that there is not even a shred of pretense in Sarawat's flirt. Not to Tine's knowledge, a few years ago, Sarawat met Tine at a Scrubb concert and fell for Tine ever since. That is how a fake flirt operation becomes true love for Sarawat and Tine whose story is told through hit songs by Scrubb.

programme.title: Mission Of Justice
programme.desc: BULLET and MOON are two tough ladies who are out to bust the biggest drug syndicate in Thailand and they only have ten days to do it! Nothing is beyond these fighting women as they enter the Golden triangle unafraid because they are on a “MISSION OF JUSTICE”! Through the jungle they pursue the dangerous Yie Feng as they track her into the very heart of Cala. Working under-cover they both find their lives at risk to the deadly Drug Lords. Only their superior fighting skills can keep them from being killed...

programme.title: Cause We Are Young
programme.desc: The friends of Choi and his girlfriend Mimi always say that the two of them do not look like a couple. So, Choi decides to change his image to be more 'punky'. However, Mimi not only spurns his changes, but also feels there are some problems between them and asks for a break-up. Paul is a 'playboy'. In a rainy night, he meets Yung. She has an unpredictable character. Paul's courtship skills do not work on her. Paul is helpless. Indeed, Yung likes Paul but she is afraid that one day she may really fall in love with Paul so she goes back to Canada. Though unwilling, Paul has to put an end to this relationship.

programme.title: Four Loves
programme.desc: The Cheng sisters, Li-fang and Li-chiung, leave war-torn Shanghai for Hong Kong. Li-chiung is rescued from robbers by Chien Pei-ling who decides to try out her luck in Hong Kong with the Chengs. They join Uncle and Aunt in Hong Kong. And they get along wonderfully with the daughter Cheng Hsiao-chuan. Li-chiung falls in love with Tony and elopes. That casts the first shadows on the friendships. It's Li-fang's turn to fall in love but both times Pei-ling steals her men. Hsiao-chuan meets Robert. A distraught Li-fang takes out a tutoring job in Macao where she falls in love. Pei-ling loves the same man...

programme.desc: Presented as a leisurely variety show, the program revolves around the theme: 'Seek Paradise Along the Journey to Kunlun Mountain.' Throughout their travels, the adventurers will uncover lesser-known towns, each exuding its own unique charm. They will explore the distinctive characteristics of these hidden gems, savoring every street and lane, as well as every bite and sip. This immersive experience seeks to rediscover the essence of life, allowing our weary hearts to shine anew amidst the dust of daily grind.
